services.name: Data import from another invoicing tool

policies.pricing: Plans start at $19 a month. Solo is $19 a month for one user. Team is $49 a month for up to 50 seats.
policies.trial: Yes. 14 days on any plan, no card needed.
policies.cancellation: Cancel any time. Billing stops at the end of the current month.
policies.payment: Card only, billed monthly in US dollars.
policies.booking: Calls are booked by email to hello@larkline.example. Agents can read slots but cannot book.
